title: Computed tomography pitfalls and diagnostic value in a patient with post-infarction ventricular septal defect, cardiogenic shock, and iatrogenic type B aortic dissection during extracorporeal membrane oxygenation support: a case report
description: Figure 2 Computed tomography (CT) images showing an aortic dissection and the intra-aortic balloon pump (IABP) catheter placed in the false lumen (FL). The entry and partial thrombosis of the false lumen is detected ( A , B ). IABP catheter tip placed in the FL (arrow, C , D ). The outer wall calcification (usually only present in the true lumen) can help to distinguish TL and the FL ( E , F ).
